headline: IDF Prepares Lebanon Strike Wave as Iran Reports Base Explosion
subheadline: Explosions expected across Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, Upper Galilee, Northern Golan and Western Galilee; Iranian AA fire active near the 15 Khordad base in Isfahan.
lede: The IDF announced an imminent wave of strikes on the Lebanon front, targeting Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, Upper Galilee, Northern Golan and Western Galilee. Simultaneously, an explosion struck near the 15 Khordad base in Isfahan at 19:50 local time, followed by intense anti‑aircraft activity in Khuzestan, while the United States evacuated tankers from RAF Mildenhall and raised FPCON Charlie at Mildenhall and Lakenheath. In the West Bank, Israeli forces demolished four illegal outposts near Burqa, Wadi Rahim and Jalud after settler violence, detaining three Israeli civilians, while continuing to permit humanitarian and dual‑use supplies into Gaza.

sections.title: Russian Drone Assault Hits Kryvyi Rih
sections.body: Russian forces launched a massed drone assault on Kryvyi Rih, producing roughly twenty explosions that struck energy infrastructure and caused widespread power and water outages. Air raid alerts were issued across Kyiv, Khmelnytskyi and Poltava as Russian Shahed drones and Geran‑5 missiles continued to threaten Ukrainian airspace. Trilateral negotiations between Ukraine, the United States and Russia opened in Abu Dhabi, with Kyiv seeking de‑escalation, a ceasefire and security guarantees. Meanwhile, a railway bridge collapse in Russia’s Arkhangelsk region was reported as a possible sabotage act, and Ukraine‑Norway talks covered delivery of air‑defence missiles and drones ahead of the Ramstein meeting.

sections.title: IDF Prepares Lebanon Strike as Iran Reports Explosion
sections.body: The IDF announced an imminent wave of strikes on the Lebanon front, with explosions expected in Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, Upper Galilee, Northern Golan and Western Galilee. An explosion occurred near the 15 Khordad base in Isfahan at 19:50 local time, followed by intense anti‑aircraft activity in Khuzestan. The United States evacuated refueling tankers from RAF Mildenhall to Germany and raised FPCON Charlie at Mildenhall and Lakenheath in response to Iranian threat intelligence. Israeli forces demolished four illegal West Bank outposts near Burqa, Wadi Rahim and Jalud after settler violence, detaining three Israeli civilians, while continuing to permit humanitarian and dual‑use supplies into Gaza.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The coordinated IDF strike preparation on the Lebanon front, simultaneous Iranian base explosion and intensified anti‑aircraft activity, and the U.S. force‑protection upgrade in Europe signal a rapid escalation risk across the Middle East. Additional indicators include Iranian launcher movements toward the Al‑Mahdi base, reported missile‑drone activity in Ukraine, and the sabotage of a railway bridge in Arkhangelsk, suggesting both state and asymmetric actions are expanding. Diplomatically, trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi and U.S. warnings to Iraq over Iran‑aligned factions reveal competing sovereignty and influence dynamics, while Israel’s continued West Bank outpost demolitions and Gaza supply allowances illustrate a dual‑track pressure and containment strategy.
